s_en: Taiwanese prosecutors are investigating Unimicron, one of the world’s largest PCB and chip substrate makers and a key supplier to Nvidia, Intel, Google, and Amazon, over allegations that it shipped China-made PCBs back to Taiwan and relabeled them as Taiwanese products.
s_zh: 臺灣檢察官正在調查Unimicron公司的指控,Unimicron是世界上最大的多氯聯苯和晶片底板製造商之一,也是Nvidia、英特爾、Google和亞馬遜的主要供應商,該公司將中國製造的多氯聯苯運回臺灣,並將其重新貼上臺灣產品的標籤。
